question_type: average of two Treasury-bill bank-discount bid quotes selected by maturity week from a month-end market-quotation table (MQ-1), with an exact half at the rounding digit
decisive_step: Use Table MQ-1 in the March 1982 issue (quotations as of Feb 26, 1982; the as-of date pins the issue, so no vintage choice) and select the two regular-weekly-panel rows whose maturity dates fall in the 2nd and 3rd weeks of June (6/10/82, 6/17/82) even though at Feb 26 those rows carry amounts only in the 26-week column; exclude the 52-week and special-issue rows with the same 6/17 date; round the exact half boundary half-up. notes: 1) Root friction: the March 1982 MQ-1 is '(untitled)' in the index because the caption 'Table MQ-1. - Treasury Bills' (1982_03.txt:4367) is separated from the pipe table (:4373) by two prose paragraphs; find_tables therefore never lists the one part every cell needed, and two cells opened the April issue first. This is a one-line-visible tool defect worth fixing before any evolution run. 2) MQ-1's flattened header has more labels than data columns; show_table's NOTES diagnosed this correctly ('labels right of it sit one column too far right', 'c6 labelled Maturity date holds num values') and every cell fell back to --raw or sed, which was the right move: keep --raw and the NOTES, but the parsed CELLS view of such tables is unusable and printings cannot address rows at all. 3) Latent rounding trap: the exact average sits on a half boundary; calc's float result prints one ulp below it and Python round() gives the lower value (a[52],[62]). Three of four cells handled it; a domain-general calc guard is cheap. 4) Controls: table_alternatives produced a false finding for b (17 wasted steps); recompute_final never fires when no calc exists (b computed mentally in both submits); spec.pins_date was False for a question that pins the quotation date. 5) The v8 losses on this question (prose in the final line; a 44-repeat loop plus compaction) did not recur: all cells ended with a bare value, and the pilot-1 loop guard fired correctly at the 3rd repeat in b. 6) The officeqa.py search helper's dict return shape cost three cells 2-4 steps each, as in v8; fix its README example or return a list.
